parameter_precedence: request.parameters is the effective numerical configuration; contract fingerprints the implementation/default recipe. Every completed worker records the effective parameters again in result.json.

semantic_sam.seed: set through upstream seed_everything; eval-mode forward has no stochastic sampling

source_guidance: original RGBA and neural predictions; no Legacy masks, anatomical boxes or manual pixel edits
determinism_note: Existing nondeterministic-algorithm settings are retained. Same-seed reproducibility requires two actual outputs; a native process crash does not establish numerical nondeterminism.
